name: outings
description: NPC friend networks and nights out. Each NPC with a home gets up to six friends, derived at boot from authored flags.friends, housemates, workmates and neighbours. In the evening a free NPC with free friends calls a night out: each walks from wherever they are to the same nearby bar or club, they meet, stay three game hours and go home. Anyone due on shift drops out. RAM only, no queries.
